'''Poptrees''' were a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] known for their sweet sap,<ref name="CSWE" /> which could be made into a [[Poptree syrup|syrup]].<ref name="MedStar I" />
